reason: The bone framework has spaces awaiting mineral, and the mineral resists compression, so this directly addresses the bone goal.
expectation: The mineral should reinforce the framework into hard bone.

alternatives.reason: The other goal suggests grouping the muscle cells with supporting tissue; either project can come first.

effect: The mineral reinforced the living bone framework, and the next bone goal is to join the bones at the elbow.
reaction: The reminder that bone retains living cells was useful.
reason: The new goal names the bones and elbow, so joining them is a clear next step.
expectation: The joint should connect the arm bones at the elbow.

alternatives.reason: Grouping the muscle cells is the other current goal.

effect: The arm bones now meet at a movable elbow, with cartilage and fluid separating their surfaces.
reaction: It was useful to see how the joint connects and braces the bones.
reason: The remaining goal calls for grouping muscle cells within supporting tissue, and those two items directly match it.
expectation: The supporting tissue should group the muscle cells into pulling tissue.

effect: The muscle cells are now grouped into bundles with tendon ends, ready to connect to the skeleton.
reaction: The picture helped explain how the supporting tissue continues into tendons.
reason: The new goal calls for connecting the muscle bundles to the skeleton, and the tendon ends provide that connection.
expectation: The muscle bundles should attach to the arm bones by their tendons.

effect: The completed arm shows how muscles attached on opposite sides pull to bend and straighten the elbow. All goals are complete.
reaction: Seeing both movements on the same skeleton made the opposite pulls easier to understand.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the muscle bundles to the skeleton was most worthwhile: the two views showed how pulling muscles can move the elbow in opposite directions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the bones to the elbow was a clear but predictable step; it felt less engaging than seeing the muscles move the joint.

surprise.text: I found it useful that bone stays living tissue, with cells and vessels, even after mineral makes it hard.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary. The goals and pictures made the pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: building the arm and seeing how its parts work together made me curious about how another body system fits together.
